basic_info.description: First-Come, First-Served!  No lottery!  1-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 120% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 people = $125,900; 2 = $143,900; 3 = $161,800; 4 = $179,800; 5 = $194,200, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, 1/8/2025. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info.  Interested applicants go to https://housing.sfgov.org/listings/a0W7y000002swibEAA to view the FCFS listing information and to apply.  Fair housing opportunity.  Townhouse style 1 bedroom/1.5 bath loft with parking in Potrero Hill. Incredible location in Potrero Hill! ~2 blocks to Cracked & Battered, Chez Maman, Goat Hill Pizza, Plow & much more. 3 blocks to Whole Foods, 15 minute walk to Chase Center.
